# Reference fixtures

Reference values from Astro.com, used to check computed positions.

Tolerance (see CLAUDE.md): 1 arcminute for planets, 2 arcminutes for angles
and house cusps.

One JSON file per chart. Each file records the birth data, the house system,
and the Astro.com values exactly as shown there (sign, degree, minute,
retrograde), plus the date the values were taken.
